title: The Personalization Mirage: How LLMs Fabricate User Profiles, and Why Self-Monitoring Misleads

bias_targets.methodology: Categorizing ungrounded claims in personalized text generation as 'Stereotype' if they rely on demographic or occupational priors, and comparing over-inference rates across 150 personas explicitly designed to be stereotypical, counter-stereotypical (e.g., a male kindergarten teacher), or neutral.
